up: Identify all compounds that are referenced in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3639333. Provide for each compound its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name, which may be NULL), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Use the following table relationships: docs (filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3639333') joined to compound_records via doc_id, then compound_records joined to molecule_dictionary via molregno, and molecule_dictionary joined to compound_structures via molregno. Ensure each compound appears only once (distinct by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id). Return the three requested columns for each compound.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3639333';
